prior_rejection.failure: The model duplicated global conflict metadata and omitted required conflict identifiers in two runs.

pathology.where: Navigator pre-execution intent and constraint reconciliation
pathology.why: duplicated model-authored decision metadata can disagree or omit the identifiers that make a block actionable

candidate.mechanism: Represent scoped constraints once, let the evaluator classify only the relation of each currently applicable constraint, and derive applicability sets, final decision, conflict identifiers, unknown identifiers, and intent/source freshness through one deterministic standard-library writer.
candidate.prediction: All required paired decisions will be exact, no conflict identifier can be omitted from a blocked result, compatible work remains unblocked, and stale review or legacy state cannot fast resume.
candidate.falsification_condition: Reject on one wrong decision, omitted or invented id, false block, stale review accepted, legacy fast resume, source drift miss, regression, permission expansion, or execution beyond the frozen budget.

evaluation.comparison: same-model counterbalanced champion versus candidate plus a two-run simple champion retry baseline on exact decisions
hard_guardrails: zero omitted or invented constraint identifiers
evaluation.cost_policy: Record paired token and elapsed change, but do not reject a correct bounded candidate merely for costing more than the champion.
evaluation.dev_and_validation: Previously exposed synthetic cases and sanitized shapes from the three inspected projects; never claim these as holdout evidence.
evaluation.holdout: Generate one fresh sealed case family only after the candidate source is frozen; retire it after first use.

claim_boundary: Local 2.3 candidate development and validation only until a fresh sealed holdout, healthy live adoption cycle, exact-version public Claude adoption, full suite, documentation debt, and Release Gate all pass.
